steps.python:
import builtins, time, av
builtins.pt_fails('view.record', 'timing is wall or frames', on=True, timing='invalid')
app.actions.run('view.record', on=True, file='${out}/fixed_frames.mp4', fps=50, timing='frames')
for _ in range(12):
    app.update(True)
    time.sleep(0.06)
r = app.actions.run('view.record', on=False)
assert r['timing'] == 'frames' and r['frames'] == 12 and r['dropped'] == 0 and abs(r['seconds'] - 0.24) < 1e-9, r
with av.open(r['file']) as video:
    assert sum(1 for _ in video.decode(video=0)) == 12, r
print('FIXED_FRAMES', r)

rec = ${rec}
assert rec['on'] and rec['file'].replace('\\', '/').endswith('/pointer.mp4'), rec
r = app.actions.run('view.record_status')
print('POINTER_REC', r)
assert r['on'] and r['width'] == 1600 and r['height'] == 900 and r['frames'] > 0, r

import builtins
assert not app.actions.run('view.stats')['playing']
p = builtins.pt_point(to='sim.toggle_play', click=True)
print('POINTER_PLAY', p)
assert p['on'] and p['error'] is None and not p['pressed'], p
assert app.actions.run('view.stats')['playing'], 'the click did not start the simulation'
p = builtins.pt_point(to='sim.toggle_play', click=True)
assert not app.actions.run('view.stats')['playing'], 'the second click did not pause it'

import builtins
p = builtins.pt_point(to='No Such Button', click=True)
print('POINTER_MISS', p)
assert p['busy'] is False and 'no visible item is labelled "No Such Button"' in p['error'], p

import builtins
c = app.actions.run('view.camera')
v = app.actions.run('view.stats')['viewport']
q = app.actions.run('view.project', point=c['target'])
cx, cy = v['x'] + 0.5 * v['width'], v['y'] + 0.5 * v['height']
print('POINTER_PROJECT', q, cx, cy)
assert q['inside'] and abs(q['x'] - cx) < 2.0 and abs(q['y'] - cy) < 2.0, (q, cx, cy)
builtins.pt_point(to=[cx, cy + 0.2 * v['height']], seconds=0.4)
p = builtins.pt_point(drag=[0.25 * v['width'], 0.0], drag_seconds=0.6)
c1 = app.actions.run('view.camera')
print('POINTER_ORBIT', c['yaw'], c1['yaw'])
assert p['error'] is None and abs(c1['yaw'] - c['yaw']) > 20.0, (c['yaw'], c1['yaw'])
p = builtins.pt_point(to=[cx, cy], wheel=4)
c2 = app.actions.run('view.camera')
print('POINTER_ZOOM', c1['distance'], c2['distance'])
assert c2['distance'] < 0.9 * c1['distance'], (c1['distance'], c2['distance'])

import builtins
fog = builtins.pt_checked('view.fog')
p = builtins.pt_point(to='View', click=True)
assert p['error'] is None, p
p = builtins.pt_point(to='Distance Fog', seconds=0.5)
assert p['error'] is None, p

import builtins
before = builtins.pt_checked('view.fog')
p = builtins.pt_point(click=True)
after = builtins.pt_checked('view.fog')
print('POINTER_MENU', before, after)
assert p['error'] is None and after != before, (before, after)

import os, subprocess
d = ${done}
print('POINTER_DONE', d)
assert d['on'] is False and d['frames'] >= 30 and d['seconds'] > 1.0 and (d['width'], d['height']) == (1600, 900), d
assert os.path.getsize(d['file']) > 10000, os.path.getsize(d['file'])
assert not os.path.exists(d['file'] + '.log')
probe = subprocess.run(['ffmpeg', '-hide_banner', '-i', d['file']], capture_output=True, text=True).stderr
print('POINTER_PROBE', [l.strip() for l in probe.splitlines() if 'Video:' in l or 'Duration' in l])
assert 'Video: h264' in probe and '1600x900' in probe, probe
assert app.actions.run('ui.pointer_status')['on'] is False
r = app.actions.run('view.record_status')
assert r['on'] is False and r['frames'] == d['frames'], r
